Chapter 857: Chapter 5: Tuoba Ancient God’s Confidence (Subscribe Please)

“This place should be considered the riverbed, right?”

Lin Yuan observed his surroundings. The more powerful the life essence of a being, the heavier its weight in the River of Time.

It would sink to the deep parts of the River of Time.

And now Lin Yuan was at the bottom of the River of Time, that is, the riverbed position.

This was already the deepest part of the River of Time, where one could sink no further.

“Many lives…”

Lin Yuan looked around. Countless specks of light floated in the River of Time, each representing a life. The vast expanse of life lights ebbed and flowed with the currents of the River of Time.

Almost all the life lights could not revive consciousness. To awaken in the River of Time, becoming aware of one’s presence within it, one must comprehend the Rule of Time.

And comprehending the Rule of Time… essentially required reaching the Eleventh Layer.

“Some ‘small fish’, and a few ‘big fish’…” Lin Yuan continued to observe while flexing his muscles in the river.

The larger the form, the clearer the sight in the River of Time, seeing further.

Those who had just comprehended the Rule of Time could only see a few tens of meters around them in the River of Time; anything beyond that was a blur.

…

“I’ll try going against the current…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself and began walking against the River of Time, heading towards the past.

After comprehending the Rule of Time, one gains the ability to travel against the current.

But generally, no Eleventh Layer being would do this, as there is no meaning to it.

Indeed, comprehending the Rule of Time allows one to move against the current, but for an Eleventh Layer being, such action is extremely strenuous.

After all, it’s going against the flow of the River of Time.

The supreme beings travel against the current specifically to revive past deceased beings.

An Eleventh Layer being going against the current? With the life essence of an Eleventh Layer, they can’t withstand the backlash of reviving deceased beings, even reviving a mere Sixth Layer being would instantly be crushed into nothingness by the mighty River of Time.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan, following the source of the River of Time, gradually stopped.

“This life light, it’s gray?” Lin Yuan looked at a light in front of him.

A gray light that no longer flows with the River of Time indicates a life that has passed away.

“With my current life essence, I should be able to withstand fishing out this life light and placing it at the newest time node, enduring the backlash…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

This is the method for ‘revival.’

Lin Yuan’s life essence is so strong that he has already been able to revive deceased Sixth Layer beings, which is considered utterly fantastical among the Ten Thousand Races of the Cosmic Starry Sky.

Since ancient times, revival has been an exclusive method of the Twelfth Layer ultimate, besides, even the most monstrous Eleventh Layer beings cannot withstand the backlash of revival.

“Reviving a Seventh Layer being…” Lin Yuan looked towards a slightly larger gray light in the distance.

Reviving this gray light, Lin Yuan felt some pressure; he could revive it but would be heavily injured under the backlash of the River of Time.

“Continue going against the current.”

Lin Yuan interestingly attempted it. An Eleventh Layer being going against the River of Time in the River is extremely strenuous, but for Lin Yuan, it was relatively easy. The surging waters of the River of Time were merely some resistance.

…

“Is this the River of Time?”

A newly enlightened Eleventh Layer being, full of excitement, surveyed his surroundings.

To comprehend the Rule of Time, among the Eleventh Layer, is to belong to the second rank, no longer a newly promoted Eleventh Layer.

“It’s so vast.”

“How to break free from such a vast River of Time…”

This Eleventh Layer being felt both excitement and despair.

To reach the Eleventh Layer, one essentially harbors the extravagant hope of breaking into the ultimate Twelfth Layer.

But the vast River of Time in sight made all Eleventh Layer beings realize…

How slim their chances of eventually entering the Twelfth Layer were.

In the River of Time, life essence is reflected, allowing one to clearly perceive the gap between oneself and the entire River of Time.

This Eleventh Layer being, even slightly going against the River of Time, found it very difficult, let alone breaking free from the River of Time.

Suddenly.

At that moment.

This newly promoted second-rank Eleventh Layer being suddenly felt a terrifying undercurrent surging from the depths of the River of Time.

The Eleventh Layer being was severely shaken by this undercurrent, taking a long time to recover.

“What exactly happened, that undercurrent…”

The Eleventh Layer being, full of doubts, tried hard to look toward the riverbed.

With his life essence, he could clearly see around him for a few tens of meters, but beyond that, it became incredibly blurry.

“What is that?”

The Eleventh Layer being tried his best to look toward the depths of the riverbed, and vaguely saw a massive entity occupying the entire riverbed, going against the River of Time towards the source.

Compared to that vague massive entity, the Eleventh Layer being seemed like an ant.

“Such a massive form, also going against the current, is it a supreme being?” This Eleventh Layer being felt a shock in his heart, sensing something was amiss.

Wasn’t it said that supreme beings have broken free from the binds of the River of Time? Why are they still in the River of Time?

…

On the banks of the River of Time.

A towering figure faintly sensed something, looking down at the vast waters.

“Hmm?”

This towering figure was naturally a Twelfth Layer ultimate, slightly puzzled as he observed the River of Time, feeling the surging waters were more tumultuous than usual.

“What could be the reason?”

The towering figure slightly furrowed his brow, but took no further action.
